A task_sync_import_conflict refusal names at most 20 task conflicts (NAMED_CONFLICT_LIMIT) in task-id order, with project entries outside the bound, and then the exact count of the rest. Tests cover 20, 21, project plus 23, a 25-root empty-folder refusal (dry run equal to real, state unchanged) and the waiver classification. The general folder-import paragraphs moved above the enrolled-destination subsection, and the omitted-file deletion now applies only to members of the last applied exchange.
